name: decode_traveling_platform_mount
definition: Reconstructs how hero.ron is flipped on/off by comparing hero.x to the platform's left/right bounds and platform width entry [6].
evidence: travel_update: nested ifs checking travs[hero.lvl][rideloop][3], [4], [6] to set hero.ron and hero.rx

name: interpret_riding_offset_assignment
definition: Sees that hero.rx is computed as platform_x minus hero_x so that later draw code can re-anchor the hero to the moving platform.
evidence: hero.rx=travs[hero.lvl][rideloop][1]-hero.x in travel_update

name: compose_tile_lookup_helper
definition: Recognizes tile_at as the composition of mget for tile id and fget for tile flags wrapped around pixel-to-tile flooring.
evidence: function tile_at(x,y) return fget(mget(flr(x/8),flr(y/8))) end

name: translate_world_offset_collision
definition: Applies the per-level world offset levels[hero.lvl][6]*8 and [7]*8 to hero coordinates before each collision tile lookup.
evidence: topleft, topright, floor_tile_below, ladder_d, ladder_u, behind all add levels[hero.lvl][6]*8 / [7]*8 in collision()

name: spot_hardcoded_platform_table
definition: Notices that the platform predicate is a literal disjunction of hand-picked hero.y values rather than a computed grid alignment.
evidence: platform = hero.y==8 or hero.y==32 or hero.y==56 ... in collision()

name: derive_ladder_direction_probes
definition: Distinguishes ladder_d and ladder_u by their probe offset (hero.h vs hero.h-1) and how each enables a different climb direction.
evidence: ladder_d = tile_at(..., hero.y+hero.h+...)==2 and ladder_u = tile_at(..., hero.y+hero.h-1+...)==2

name: match_door_tile_range
definition: Maps tile flag values 60-69 to door numbers via the (tile-59) arithmetic to look up the right key and door sprite.
evidence: if (topleft>=60 and topleft<=69) then dnum=(topleft-59); dsprite=(topleft-55) in collision()

name: decode_treasure_flag_range
definition: Interprets tile range 34-44 as the treasure pickup band and maps it back to a booty index via (behind-33).
evidence: if (behind>=34) and (behind<=44) then onum=(behind-33); booty[hero.lvl][onum][3]=0 in collision()

name: trace_key_state_swap
definition: Follows how an existing held key has its keydb status set to 1 before knum becomes the new hero.keyheld on a key pickup.
evidence: if not (hero.keyheld==0 or keydb[hero.lvl][hero.keyheld][3]==2) then keydb[hero.lvl][hero.keyheld][3]=1 ... hero.keyheld=knum

name: infer_falling_death_condition
definition: Combines three predicates â€” no floor tile, no fading platform on, and not climbing â€” to recognize the death trigger.
evidence: if floor_tile_below==0 and tempon==false and climb==false then hero.death=true in collision()

name: trace_lift_direction_toggle
definition: Follows the four-branch dir flag (0/1) state machine in objects() that bounces lift y between its start [3] and end [4] bounds.
evidence: lifts[hero.lvl][liftloop][5]==0 / ==1 blocks comparing [2] to [3] and [4] in objects()

name: identify_random_trap_assignment
definition: Recognizes that trap is overwritten every frame inside the items loop, making the bomb selection effectively unstable.
evidence: trap=rnd(levels[hero.lvl][2]) placed inside the for items loop in objects()

name: spot_shuffle_swap_idiom
definition: Identifies the Lua multi-assignment swap as a Fisher-Yates-like shuffle, picking two random indices and exchanging items.
evidence: items[rand1], items[rand2] = items[rand2], items[rand1] in function shuffle

name: decode_zspr_scaling_blit
definition: Unpacks how zspr converts a sprite index n into source x/y via modulo/floor and feeds sspr with destination width = source width * dz.
evidence: sx = 8 * (n % 16); sy = 8 * flr(n / 16); dw = sw * dz; sspr(sx,sy,sw,sh,dx,dy,dw,dh) in zspr

name: recognize_mode_dispatch_pattern
definition: Sees _draw and _update as parallel dispatchers that route to per-mode draw/update functions based on the global mode integer.
evidence: function _draw and function _update with elseif chains on mode == 0/9/6/3 dispatching to titledraw/deathdraw/etc.

name: parse_wavy_text_sine
definition: Sees how each character's y position is offset by sin((tim+i)/speed)*height to produce a per-letter wave animation.
evidence: for i=0,#text,1 do print(sub(text,i,i), 32+(i*4), 16+sin((tim+i)/speed)*height,7) in titledraw and windraw

name: locate_empty_callback_stubs
definition: Notes that titleupdate, deathupdate, helpupdate, and winupdate are empty placeholders kept only to satisfy the dispatch table.
evidence: function titleupdate() end / function deathupdate() end etc. at the bottom of the chunk

name: identify_draw_callback_function
definition: Recognizes gamedraw as the per-frame render routine by spotting cls() followed by map() and sprite draws.
evidence: function gamedraw() starting with cls() and map(levels[hero.lvl][6],...)

name: decode_level_table_indexing
definition: Interprets the meaning of each numeric index into levels[hero.lvl][n] (e.g., [5]=pirate count, [10]=fading platform count, [11]/[12]=spawn x/y) from context.
evidence: levels[hero.lvl][5], levels[hero.lvl][10], levels[hero.lvl][11], levels[hero.lvl][12] used throughout gamedraw and gameupdate

name: trace_cheat_flag_branches
definition: Follows how the cheat[] array gates entire rendering and behavior branches such as drawing pirates or alternate ladders.
evidence: if cheat[2]==0 then ... draw pirates and if cheat[6]==1 then ... draw alt ladders

name: recognize_riding_platform_offset
definition: Understands that hero.x is being reassigned to a platform's x minus a rider-relative offset hero.rx when hero.ron is true.
evidence: if hero.ron==true then hero.x=travs[hero.lvl][1][1]-hero.rx

name: parse_fading_platform_loop
definition: Reconstructs how a fading platform's span is drawn by stepping from platstart to platend in eight-pixel increments based on its width entry.
evidence: platend = platstart + (templatforms[hero.lvl][fadeloop][3]*8); for platpart = platstart, platend, 8 do spr(1,...)

name: infer_exit_proximity_check
definition: Composes the bounding-box test that detects whether the hero is standing in front of an exit tile before allowing level transition.
evidence: exits[hero.lvl][exitloop][1]>=flr(hero.x)-7 and ...<=flr(hero.x)+7 inside the behind==192 block

name: detect_button_input_mapping
definition: Maps btn(0..3) calls to left/right/up/down directional intent and btnp(4)/btnp(5) to action presses.
evidence: btn(0) and platform (left), btn(1) (right), btn(2) (up), btn(3) (down), btnp(5) for exit confirm

name: predict_sprite_animation_cycle
definition: Sees how move(sprite) advances hero.sp and wraps it back to a base frame using hero.ani as a frame count.
evidence: function move(sprite): hero.sp += 1; if hero.sp > sprite+hero.ani then hero.sp = sprite end

name: derive_fadewait_timing_formula
definition: Works out how the longest platform width is scanned for and then used to compute fadewait and toggle tempon via time() modulo arithmetic.
evidence: maxwidth loop, fadewait = 2+(maxwidth-3), if (time() % fadewait)==0 then tempon=true

name: track_pirate_facing_state
definition: Follows how pilocate[lvl][n][3] encodes pirate facing direction and is flipped at gap edges, screen edges, and wall tiles.
evidence: pilocate[hero.lvl][enemies][3]==false / ==true branches in enemy_update with assignments at gap edges and bounds checks

name: interpret_tile_range_collision
definition: Reads tile_at() return values against the 60-68 inclusive range as the wall-tile predicate that triggers pirate turnaround.
evidence: tile_at(...)>=60 and tile_at(...)<=68 in enemy_update's top-right and top-left turnaround blocks

name: match_world_to_screen_coords
definition: Composes the world-to-screen translation by adding levels[hero.lvl][6]*8 and [7]*8 to pirate coordinates before tile lookup.
evidence: tile_at(pilocate[hero.lvl][enemies][1]+4+levels[hero.lvl][6]*8, pilocate[hero.lvl][enemies][2]-8 + levels[hero.lvl][7]*8)

name: spot_buggy_respawn_assignment
definition: Notices that fall() assigns hero.x twice instead of restoring hero.y, recognizing it as a copy-paste bug.
evidence: hero.x=levels[hero.lvl][11]; hero.x=levels[hero.lvl][12] inside function fall()

name: identify_mode_transition_triggers
definition: Spots the conditions that flip the global mode variable to switch the game out of normal play (death screen or win).
evidence: if hero.lives==0 then mode = 9 and if hero.treas==125 then mode =6 at end of gameupdate

name: locate_door_unlock_sideeffects
definition: Catalogs the multiple side effects of deldoor: sfx, fset flag removal, array mutation, three mset tile rewrites, and key consumption.
evidence: function deldoor(): sfx(13), fset(dsprite,0), doors[...][3]=0, three mset calls, hero.keyheld=0

name: compute_remaining_treasure_total
definition: Follows the per-level loop that sums booty[hero.lvl][taken][3] into total to detect level completion.
evidence: for taken = 1,levels[hero.lvl][2] do total += booty[hero.lvl][taken][3] end; if total == 0 then centre_print("level complete",113)
